native_primary: proposed gpt-6.1-sol; exact capability must be qualified
native_worker: proposed gpt-6-luna; same source subscription required
hypothesis: Availability-gated subtask delegation using similar verified actions and experience recency improves the failure-inclusive parent-plus-worker accuracy-cost frontier.

similarity.implementation: 0.60 lexical token-set cosine + 0.25 matching category + 0.15 action-set Jaccard
similarity.parent_deduplication: one observation per earlier task; relevant failure dominates correlated successes

recency.age_anchor: verified execution/check timestamp, not import or publication time
recency.estimate: (1 + weighted_successes) / (2 + weighted_support); descriptive, not calibrated probability
recency.worker_packet_control: Fixed similarity order/byte budget across evidence-based arms; v1 changes age admission, not simultaneous worker prompt ordering.

age_variation_gate.missing_variation: Report recency question unidentifiable; do not force an improvement.

recency.secondary_control: Similarity-only comparator selected on development data for matched cheap coverage/cost; test selections remain frozen.

availability: qualified same-account unexpired capability receipt, required tools, strictly lower relative cost under one frozen rate scenario
fallback: return needs_parent; no automatic Sol invocation

native_stages.launch_policy: Each stage needs its own positive finite budgets and immutable source/model/evaluator/reservation freeze; task counts are proposed, not automatically launched.

retrospective_replay.mode: exploratory leave-one-task-out; all other historical evidence available as of replay time
retrospective_replay.exposure: All 11 original tasks/results are previously exposed; no new holdout or prospective grade-publication chronology is claimed.
retrospective_replay.age_proxy: native completion timestamps; actual historical grade publication time is not inferred
retrospective_replay.availability: simulated same-source capability and relative cost ordering only; cannot authorize native execution
retrospective_replay.cost: sum selected historical execution scenario costs; excludes unobserved new parent/delegation/lookup overhead
retrospective_replay.inference: policy diagnostic only; not evidence of live subtask delegation savings or recency superiority
